answer: Audits are recorded in orchard, queued in willow, and crystal publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 86 identities per epoch. A farm of 200 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3867 identities would post 1717 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
